description: Run the Marxan optimiser on the example project's planning data (Exmouth Gulf, Western Australia only): the cheapest set of planning squares that meets every habitat target. `protect` = planning-square ids always included (understand_area returns them as `pus`); `target_pct` = one target for every habitat, in %. Takes a few seconds; returns the summary, each habitat's result and the best solution. Nothing is saved to your projects.
name: simulate
title: Run the protection options (Marxan)
